rule_0.statement: A bonded matter skeleton articulates kernel-conformantly under THE JOINTS-ARE-MATERIALS LAW: an articulation-class bond keeps every field it has (material, members, cure 13 MPa, rest_length = the measured law gap) and gains three records — joint_class (cited), pivot_mm (DERIVED from committed geometry, for the hip the femoral-head center fit on bone_02's committed vertices), and a closed anatomical range (CITED to the sha-pinned OpenSim records already held on this lineage, adult band with the infant stage gap named, never tuned). A pose is top-level recorded state (the pose_contacts move, repeated for state: default theta=0 IS the scanned corpse-pose); posed geometry is the RIGID Rodrigues transform of the child membrane about (pivot, axis), so mass is exactly invariant and theta=0 reproduces the committed bytes; cure keeps its number and gains its rotational reader (dislocation = bond failure at exactly cure*A at any theta); a pose enters physics only through a named force or torque.
rule_0.prediction: The §5 preregistration of docs/THE_ARTICULATION_LAW.md, verbatim: P1 rest identity (posed bone_02 bytes hash-equal tris/bone_02.bin at theta=0) · P2 seat through range (closest-point gap posed bone_02<->bone_01 stays <= the 3.0 mm touching-class cut at the cited range endpoints) · P3 cure invariance (glue.py pull_bond: identical failure_force_n = cure*A at theta=0 and at each endpoint) · P4 mass exact (derived mass of posed bone_02 equals rest to float equality) · P5 range stop (beyond the recorded range refuses out_of_anatomical_range, never clamps) · P6 the control's teeth (the SAME protocol on the NULL pivot — the recorded closest-points midpoint — BREACHES the 3.0 mm cut at range extremes; if the null arm passes, the pivot derivation does no work and the design's pivot law is void).

survey_answer: THE KERNEL DOES NOT ARTICULATE TODAY. tools/matter_kernel's rotational-keyword grep returns one hit: the English word 'moment' in tensile.py's docstring. The four committed laws (sourced constants L1; mass derived from geometry L2; bonds are materials with required per-bond cure L3; force is a required input L4) have no rotational clause; glue.py's pull law F_fail = min(cure*A_glue, yield_a*A_a, yield_b*A_b) is normal-pull only. Rotation exists in the house in exactly three places, all reused by the design: the engine's hinge columns (ChimeraEngine/engine/shaders/joints.comp: per-joint 8-float [J, axis, 0, theta] + ROM limits j_rom_ + FK/LBS + the M1 matter pass; a TREE), the captured-pivot statics (docs/THE_CATEGORIES.md joint v1 / lever v6: rotation emerges from pull + fulcrum; torque law exact to 0.000; the saddle captures the arm so rotation is the only free DOF), and the gait engines' published ranges (tools/train_stand.py reads m.jnt_range 'from the model. No defaults'; seat_in_limits: the keyframe sat 10.4 deg beyond the body's own declared hip stop — THE REWARD WAS NEVER THE DEFECT). KERNEL_SPEC.md is cited by the kernel but is NOT committed on this branch (honesty line, §1.1).
